content.short: ChainGPT offers AI tools for crypto research, smart contract generation, auditing, and Web3 product workflows.
content.description: ChainGPT is a Web3 focused AI platform that packages several blockchain oriented tools into one product suite. Its offerings include a crypto chatbot, smart contract generator, smart contract auditor, trading assistant, and other utility flows aimed at teams and users working in digital assets. The company also runs launch and incubation products around new blockchain projects. For Mantle builders, ChainGPT is most relevant as an external tooling layer that can help with contract drafting, security review support, and faster research or content workflows around a live ecosystem product.
content.meta: ChainGPT brings AI research and smart contract tooling to Mantle related workflows.
